name: R04 Budget vs Actual by Cost Center

statements:
SELECT
  FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR,
  COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_NAME,
  COST_CENTERS.DEPARTMENT,
  SUM(GL_JOURNAL_LINES.REVENUE_AMOUNT),
  SUM(GL_JOURNAL_LINES.EXPENSE_AMOUNT)
FROM
  CNR_FIN.COST_CENTERS  COST_CENTERS,
  CNR_FIN.FISCAL_PERIODS  FISCAL_PERIODS,
  CNR_FIN.GL_JOURNAL_LINES  GL_JOURNAL_LINES
WHERE
  ( GL_JOURNAL_LINES.COST_CENTER_ID=COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_ID  )
  AND  ( GL_JOURNAL_LINES.PERIOD_ID=FISCAL_PERIODS.PERIOD_ID  )
  AND  ( FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR = 2025 )
GROUP BY
  FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR,
  COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_NAME,
  COST_CENTERS.DEPARTMENT

SELECT
  FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR,
  COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_NAME,
  COST_CENTERS.DEPARTMENT,
  SUM(BUDGET_LINES.REVENUE_BUDGET),
  SUM(BUDGET_LINES.EXPENSE_BUDGET)
FROM
  CNR_FIN.BUDGET_LINES  BUDGET_LINES,
  CNR_FIN.COST_CENTERS  COST_CENTERS,
  CNR_FIN.FISCAL_PERIODS  FISCAL_PERIODS
WHERE
  ( BUDGET_LINES.COST_CENTER_ID=COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_ID  )
  AND  ( BUDGET_LINES.PERIOD_ID=FISCAL_PERIODS.PERIOD_ID  )
  AND  ( FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR = 2025 )
GROUP BY
  FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR,
  COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_NAME,
  COST_CENTERS.DEPARTMENT
